name: Swig
source:
The resident crack shot and drunken panda who mans the base cannons. Swig watched over [url=/c742]Deuce[/url] and [url=/c745]Tessa[/url] in their youths. He is jolly and is always happy to share a drink, much to the dismay of Deuce. Underneath his fur lies a sad panda.

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
